hook: Never give your dog grapes or raisins — it could be fatal.
caption: Never give your dog grapes or raisins — it could be fatal. These snacks can severely harm their kidneys. What other human foods do you think are dangerous for pets? #DogSafety #PetCare #SouthAfrica #HealthyPets #PetOwners
